name: 12-coevolving-rewiring-network
title: Dynamics on a rewiring network — synchrony survives continual rewiring
question: Do the coupled oscillators stay synchronised when the very edges that couple them are continuously rewired?
hypothesis: With the topology continuously small-world-rewired under the running reactors (node and edge counts conserved), the coupling remains strong enough to reach and hold synchrony.
objective: Run the rewiring_repressilator_network composite — SBML reactors + transport on a topology that a PBG reaction reconfigures during the run — and measure synchrony.
description:
Coupled SBML oscillators synchronise and stay synchronised even as the coupling edges are continuously rewired — reaction–diffusion is robust to an evolving (but well-connected) topology.

This is a Family-C (co-evolution) study: a Family-A reaction reconfigures the graph WHILE the Family-B SBML reactors + inter-node transport run on it. See viz/ for the concentration-on-network animation and the per-node time series.
claim: Coupled SBML oscillators synchronise and stay synchronised even as the coupling edges are continuously rewired — reaction–diffusion is robust to an evolving (but well-connected) topology.

findings.name: rewiring_repressilator_network-result
findings.summary: Coupled SBML oscillators synchronise and stay synchronised even as the coupling edges are continuously rewired — reaction–diffusion is robust to an evolving (but well-connected) topology.
findings.detail: The same 12 reactors on a ring whose edges are continuously small-world-rewired while the oscillators run (node and edge counts conserved, only the wiring changes). Because rewiring preserves connectivity and degree, the coupling stays effective: the oscillators reach and hold synchrony (across-node spread → 0) despite the topology never standing still — the companion to the growing-network study.

followup_proposals.title: Stochastic (Gillespie) reactors at the nodes
followup_proposals.motivation: The deterministic Repressilator can relax toward a limit cycle; stochastic kinetics sustain noisier oscillations and stress-test whether coupling still synchronises.
